overall_goal: Add more stock to the risotto and continue to simmer and stir

goals.description: Add broth to the risotto and stir
goals.rationale: The person pours more broth into the frying pan, checks the burner setting for simmering, and stirs the mixture.

goals.description: Continue stirring the risotto as it simmers
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly stirs the contents of the frying pan and taps the spatula to prevent burning and ensure even cooking.
